metadata.question: Was there more sea ice visible in Hudson Bay (56.271030, -87.160422) on July 29, 2020 than on July 13, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 Level-2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) over a 25 km buffer around the point in Hudson Bay.
- Query exact day windows [day, day+1). If no images, expand to ±1 day (3-day window).
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use SCL band to (a) include only water or ice (classes 6 and 11), and (b) count ice (class 11). This implicitly avoids clouds (classes 8–10) because we only admit water/ice.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size is 0 after expansion: C1.
- If valid water/ice pixel count is 0: C2.
- If fraction is null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare ice fraction (July 29 > July 13 -> A, else B).

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function evaluateAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lon = -87.160422;
  const lat = 56.27103;
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(25000); // 25 km buffer
  const d1 = '2020-07-13';
  const d2 = '2020-07-29';

  async function analyzeDate(dateStr) {
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const end = start.advance(1, 'day');

    function s2Col(s, e) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(s, e)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
    }

    let col = s2Col(start, end);
    let size = await evaluateAsync(col.size());
    let windowLabel = 'd1';

    if (size === 0) {
      const start2 = start.advance(-1, 'day');
      const end2 = end.advance(1, 'day');
      col = s2Col(start2, end2);
      size = await evaluateAsync(col.size());
      windowLabel = 'd3';
      if (size === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1', date: dateStr, imgs: 0, window: windowLabel };
      }
    }

    const meanCloud = await evaluateAsync(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'));
    const mosaic = col.mosaic();

    // Build masks: allowed water or ice (SCL 6 or 11), and ice only (SCL 11)
    const scl = mosaic.select('SCL');
    const allowed = scl.eq(6).or(scl.eq(11)).rename('allowed').selfMask(); // water or ice only
    const ice = scl.eq(11).rename('ice').updateMask(allowed);

    const validCountDict = allowed.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const iceSumDict = ice.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });

    const valid = await evaluateAsync(validCountDict.get('allowed'));
    const icePix = await evaluateAsync(iceSumDict.get('ice'));

    if (valid === null || valid === 0) {
      return {
        status: 'C2',
        date: dateStr,
        imgs: size,
        window: windowLabel,
        meanCloud: meanCloud,
        valid: valid || 0,
        ice: icePix || 0,
        frac: null
      };
    }

    const frac = (icePix === null) ? null : (icePix / valid);
    if (frac === null || !isFinite(frac)) {
      return {
        status: 'C3',
        date: dateStr,
        imgs: size,
        window: windowLabel,
        meanCloud: meanCloud,
        valid: valid,
        ice: icePix || 0,
        frac: null
      };
    }

    return {
      status: 'ok',
      date: dateStr,
      imgs: size,
      window: windowLabel,
      meanCloud: meanCloud,
      valid: valid,
      ice: icePix,
      frac: frac
    };
  }

  try {
    const r1 = await analyzeDate(d1);
    const r2 = await analyzeDate(d2);

    function fmt(n, digits = 4) {
      if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return 'NA';
      return (typeof n === 'number') ? n.toFixed(digits) : String(n);
    }

    // Print concise evidence lines (max 20 lines total)
    if (r1.status === 'ok') {
      console.log(`${r1.date} S2 imgs:${r1.imgs} win:${r1.window} meanCloud:${fmt(r1.meanCloud,1)} valid:${r1.valid} ice:${r1.ice} frac:${fmt(r1.frac,4)}`);
    } else if (r1.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`${r1.date} S2 imgs:0 win:${r1.window} -> C1`);
    } else if (r1.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`${r1.date} S2 imgs:${r1.imgs} win:${r1.window} valid:${r1.valid} -> C2`);
    } else if (r1.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`${r1.date} S2 imgs:${r1.imgs} win:${r1.window} calc:null -> C3`);
    }

    if (r2.status === 'ok') {
      console.log(`${r2.date} S2 imgs:${r2.imgs} win:${r2.window} meanCloud:${fmt(r2.meanCloud,1)} valid:${r2.valid} ice:${r2.ice} frac:${fmt(r2.frac,4)}`);
    } else if (r2.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`${r2.date} S2 imgs:0 win:${r2.window} -> C1`);
    } else if (r2.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`${r2.date} S2 imgs:${r2.imgs} win:${r2.window} valid:${r2.valid} -> C2`);
    } else if (r2.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`${r2.date} S2 imgs:${r2.imgs} win:${r2.window} calc:null -> C3`);
    }

    // Determine final tag
    let finalTag = null;
    if (r1.status === 'C1' || r2.status === 'C1') {
      finalTag = 'C1';
    } else if (r1.status === 'C2' || r2.status === 'C2') {
      finalTag = 'C2';
    } else if (r1.status === 'C3' || r2.status === 'C3') {
      finalTag = 'C3';
    } else {
      // Both ok
      finalTag = (r2.frac > r1.frac) ? 'A' : 'B';
    }

    console.log(finalTag);
  } catch (err) {
    // In case of API, band, or other runtime issues
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
